$comment: Route file of the desktop host pack, read by the kit's paperflow-route hook. keywords: whole-word regular-expression fragments that mark a prompt as work on a WPF window; a project adds its own under routing.hosts.desktop.keywords. A desktop app has no live lane, so liveFirst is false and the loop is the ui lane's own: red on mock data first, the real screen last.
loop: red - a UI test on mock data, seen failing on its assertion
green - the view and view model until it passes
look - open every screenshot and judge it against the plan's wireframe (skill drive-wpf)
